data.title: init writes session hooks for Codex, Cursor and Copilot; prompt hook for Codex only
data.why: Only these three run a project-level shell command whose output reaches the model, and do it outside preview. Codex has SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, both injecting. Cursor and Copilot inject only at session start: Cursor's beforeSubmitPrompt can only block, and Copilot drops the output of command hooks on userPromptSubmitted. The hook took journal use from 1 in 10 to 9 in 10 (KAD-53), so where one exists it is worth writing. Sources in docs/research/agent-hooks-2026-10.md.
data.rejected: AGENTS.md everywhere and no hooks: measured at 1 in 10; Every agent that has any hook (Cline, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Amp, opencode): Cline needs an opt-in and an executable per event, and its injection was fixed only on 2026-09-22; Gemini CLI is being retired; Antigravity's session event is unconfirmed; Amp and opencode need TypeScript plugins, not shell commands
